tokens.name: color-carbon
tokens.usage: Anchor dark — text, line work, heavy fills. Warm near-black, never pure #000. Every composition uses it with color-hueso; text on color-hueso 12.7:1, on bg-page 13.4:1.

tokens.name: color-hueso
tokens.usage: Anchor light — page backgrounds, raised surfaces. Warm off-white, never pure #FFF or cream. Text colour on color-carbon, color-buganvilia-deep (4.8:1) and color-mar-caribe (3.4:1 — below 4.5:1 for small text, a source pair kept as is).

tokens.name: color-mar-caribe
tokens.usage: Activity colour: marks that something moves or changes state — selected rows, switches on, sliders, focus rings, active links. Also the default hero accent for studio surfaces. Non-text use on light grounds (3.4–3.6:1); for fills that carry text use color-mar-caribe-deep.

tokens.name: color-mar-caribe-deep
tokens.usage: Text-bearing Mar Caribe fills in light mode — selected table rows, the Mar Caribe button — with Hueso text (5.0:1).

tokens.name: color-sol-de-maiz
tokens.usage: Hero yellow — for sun-warm or competition pieces; pick one hero per page. Carry Carbón text on it (7.5:1).

tokens.name: color-salmon
tokens.usage: Warm supporting accent. Pairs naturally with color-mar-caribe.

tokens.name: color-cielo-llanero
tokens.usage: Cool supporting accent. Bridges to LeCorbusier 32-030.

tokens.name: color-tierra
tokens.usage: Structural neutral mid-gray. Secondary text, dividers, muted chart series. Not a border colour in dark mode: dark borders are Hueso (color-border-dark).

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Borders in light mode: buttons, fields, chips, tables, checkboxes, cards. 1.5 px.

tokens.name: color-border-dark
tokens.usage: Borders in dark mode, on every component and chart — Tierra read as a blur on dark grounds (2026-11). 1.5 px.

tokens.name: color-buganvilia
tokens.usage: Accent — punctuation, not paragraph: max one element per screen. Dots, borders, accent shadows and fills without text. Mar Caribe, not Buganvilia, signals activity.

tokens.name: color-buganvilia-deep
tokens.usage: Text-bearing Buganvilia fills (badges, buttons) — pair with color-hueso text (4.8:1).

tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Web page background, light — Hueso since 2026-11 (was #f7f3ec). The anchor colour is the ground; cards sit on it a step lighter. Text-primary on it 12.7:1.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Web surface, light — a step lighter than the Hueso ground, 'paper on a table' (1.11:1 against bg-page). Default Card fill. Text-primary 14.1:1, text-secondary 3.5:1.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body text on bg-page and bg-surface — same as Carbón.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and captions on bg-page / bg-surface — same as Tierra. 3.3:1 on bg-page and 3.1:1 on bg-surface: below 4.5:1 for small text (source value kept; flagged).

tokens.name: bg-page-dark
tokens.usage: Web page background, dark — deeper than Carbón for surface separation.

tokens.name: bg-surface-dark
tokens.usage: Web surface, dark — a step lighter than bg-page-dark (1.39:1), so cards read without a border. Hueso text 10.9:1, text-secondary-dark 5.1:1.

tokens.name: text-primary-dark
tokens.usage: Body text on bg-page-dark (15.2:1) and bg-surface-dark (12.7:1).

tokens.name: text-secondary-dark
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg-surface-dark (5.9:1) and bg-page-dark (7.1:1) — Tierra lifted.

tokens.name: color-mar-caribe-on-dark
tokens.usage: Lifted Mar Caribe for dark-mode UI, on bg-page-dark / bg-surface-dark.

tokens.name: color-salmon-on-dark
tokens.usage: Lifted Salmón for dark-mode UI.

tokens.name: color-cielo-llanero-on-dark
tokens.usage: Lifted Cielo Llanero for dark-mode UI.

tokens.name: color-buganvilia-on-dark
tokens.usage: Lifted Buganvilia for dark-mode UI — still max one element per screen.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Semantic: Buena. Badge success fill; Hueso text on it reaches only 2.5:1 (source pair kept; flagged) — status badges always carry a word.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Semantic: Atención. Carry Carbón text on it (6.8:1).

tokens.name: color-error
tokens.usage: Semantic: Error — warm red, not neon.

tokens.name: color-info
tokens.usage: Semantic: Destacado — same as Cielo Llanero.

radius.note: Square corners. Radius 0 everywhere; only circular controls (radio, status dot) are round.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for every container: buttons, inputs, cards, tabs, tables, badges, switches.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Circular controls only: radio buttons and status dots. Never on containers.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Deprecated (was 4px). Alias of radius-none, kept so older consumers don't break.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Deprecated (was 8px). Use radius-none.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Deprecated (was 12px). Use radius-none.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Deprecated (was 999px for pill badges). Badges are square now; use radius-none.

shadow.note: Hard offsets only, no blur, no stacked shadows. Solid shadows default to 4px; patterned shadows (45° stripes, dots) always 8px, and a solid shadow next to a patterned one goes to 8px too. Patterns are for special cards; buttons keep solid shadows. Accent shadows (Mar Caribe, Maíz, Buganvilia) highlight an element quietly — see the .aaj-shadow helpers in components/bundle.css.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-lg-dark

tokens.name: shadow-hairline
tokens.usage: Hairline elevation — only when an element needs a suggestion of lift without a hard shadow.
